title: The State of Large Language Models for African Languages: Progress and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative analysis mapping the number of supported African languages, tokenization disparities, and available benchmark datasets across commercial LLMs, foundational Small Language Models (SLMs), and Specialized SLMs to highlight the systemic underrepresentation of low-resource languages.

Auditing language model support across 37 historically and currently active African writing systems to quantify the exclusion of indigenous scripts compared to dominant scripts like Latin, Arabic, and Ge'ez.
